items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯官方幽默回应了领队托托·沃尔夫在意大利大奖赛排位赛中的愤怒瞬间。蒙扎Q3最后时刻，阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利以0.060秒优势击败梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔夺杆，沃尔夫被拍到愤然击打车库计时台。

items.summaryEn: Mercedes has poked fun at its own team principal Toto Wolff after he was filmed striking his garage timing console in frustration during Italian Grand Prix qualifying. detailZh: 梅赛德斯在意大利大奖赛排位赛愤怒时刻后调侃托托·沃尔夫
在皮埃尔·加斯利抢走乔治·拉塞尔的蒙扎杆位时，托托·沃尔夫被发现愤怒地敲击他的计时控制台
在意大利大奖赛排位赛期间，托托·沃尔夫被拍到愤怒地敲击车队车库里的计时控制台，梅赛德斯随后调侃了自家的领队。
沃尔夫的这一反应发生在蒙扎Q3的最后时刻，当时阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利意外夺得杆位，仅以0.060秒的优势击败梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔，登上榜首。
这家位于布拉克利的车队分享了自己对那一刻的幕后视角，并配上文字：“这条视频献给所有的电脑屏幕，我们很抱歉——我们只是真的很想为乔治·拉塞尔拿下杆位。但还是要祝贺阿尔派。”,
有人从镜头后面问沃尔夫屏幕有没有事、发生了什么。“没事，”他说，“我只是太希望乔治能拿到杆位了。他当时是场上最快的车。然后我们在最后一圈被影响了，所以……唉，挺恼人的。”
他还说：“我为阿尔派感到高兴。我们（作为梅赛德斯的客户车队）在其中也出了一小份力，而他们拿到杆位意义不同，他们干得很出色。”,
截至撰写本文时，梅赛德斯分享的这段视频的观看次数已超过13.4万次。“愤怒的托托，我们想你了！”一位车迷评论道。
在排位赛结束后接受天空体育 F1采访时，沃尔夫解释说，加斯利不能被排除在意大利大奖赛的威胁之外。
"你总是需要认真对待每一个人," 他说。"他们拥有极高的直线速度。他们削减了大量空气阻力。
"而在单圈计时中，这被证明是必要的。但正赛完全是另一回事。所以让我们拭目以待。"
拉塞尔将在意大利大奖赛的发车前排与加斯利并肩，从第二位起步。虽然迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里排位赛获得第三，但由于在2号弯阻挡了劳森，他被处以退三位发车的处罚。因此，法拉利的勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿将分别从第三位和第四位起步。
detailEn: Mercedes pokes fun at Toto Wolff after angry Italian GP qualifying moment
Toto Wolff was caught striking his timing console in frustration as Pierre Gasly denied George Russell pole at Monza
Mercedes has poked fun at its own team principal Toto Wolff after he was filmed striking his garage timing console in frustration during qualifying for the Italian Grand Prix.

Wolff's reaction was triggered in the final moments of Q3 at Monza when Alpine's Pierre Gasly secured a surprise pole position, beating Mercedes driver George Russell to the top spot by just 0.060 seconds.

The Brackley outfit shared its own behind-the-scenes view of the moment, with the caption: "This goes out to all computer screens, we’re sorry - we just really wanted that Pole for George Russell. But congratulations to Alpine."

Wolff was asked from behind the camera if the screen was OK and what had happened. "It's OK," he said. "I just cared so much for George to be on pole. He was the quickest car out there. And then we got compromised in the last lap, so... yeah, that was annoying."
He added: "I'm happy for Alpine. We played a little part in there [as a Mercedes customer team] and them being on pole is something different, and they've done a good job."
At the time of writing, the clip shared by Mercedes had already been seen over 134,000 times. "Angry Toto, we missed you!" one fan commented.
While speaking to Sky Sports F1 following qualifying, Wolff explained that Gasly cannot be counted out as a threat for the Italian Grand Prix.
"You always need to take everybody seriously," he said. "They have a huge amount of straightline speed. They've taken away a lot of drag.
"And on a single lap, that proved to be what is necessary. The race is a completely different ballgame. So we shall see."

Russell will start alongside Gasly on the front row of the Italian Grand Prix from second. While McLaren's Oscar Piastri qualified third, he was handed a three-place grid penalty for impeding Liam Lawson at Turn 2. As a result, Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton will start from third and fourth, respectively.

items.summaryZh: 兰斯·斯特罗尔在意大利大奖赛排位赛中垫底，成为自2006年三阶段排位赛制度引入以来首位达到100次Q1淘汰的车手。

items.originalTitle: 兰斯·斯特罗尔成为F1首位达到100次Q1淘汰的车手
items.summaryEn: Lance Stroll set an unwanted Formula 1 record by becoming the first driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations since the three-part qualifying system was introduced in 2006. The Canadian qualified last for Sunday's Italian Grand Prix, just under a tenth slower than team-mate Fernando Alonso.
detailZh: 兰斯·斯特罗尔成为首位在Q1被淘汰达100次的F1车手
这位阿斯顿·马丁车手在蒙扎排位垫底，成为自2006年F1引入三节排位赛制以来首位达到这一百次里程碑的车手
兰斯·斯特罗尔创下了一项他并不想要的F1纪录，成为自2006年引入三节排位赛制以来首位累计100次在Q1被淘汰的车手。
这位加拿大车手在周日意大利大奖赛的排位中垫底，结束时仅比队友费尔南多·阿隆索慢了不到十分之一秒——尽管阿隆索未能在排位赛尾声完成最后一飞。
这延续了一个周末的局势：尽管阿斯顿·马丁在赞德沃特因本田升级版动力单元的到来以及用于增强其匈牙利大规模升级的额外改进而得到提振，但其整体动力不足的问题仍然暴露无遗。
AMR26的速度始终比梅赛德斯的赛车慢20公里/小时，这也是它在Q1中落后皮埃尔·加斯利的阿尔派全场2.6秒的主要原因。
然而，斯托尔在回答时一如既往地简短生硬，他对阿斯顿·马丁缺乏速度完全不感到意外。对于周日正赛的前景，他的热情——或者说热情的缺失——也没有任何提升，这暗示着两辆绿车在整场比赛中都将远远落后。
"引擎的表现和我们的预期一致，"他说，"我们慢了三秒，所以明天我们不可能跟上大部队。"
斯特罗尔在2017年澳大利亚大奖赛代表威廉姆斯出战的首场F1比赛中就在Q1被淘汰，这是他职业生涯的第一次，当时他距离马库斯·埃里克森慢了0.9秒，后者是那个周末最后一位晋级Q2的车手。
随后一周在上海，他反弹闯入Q3，不过与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的碰撞让他的比赛在第一圈就告终。然而，斯特罗尔在蒙特利尔的主场比赛中拿下了个人首个F1积分，随后又在混乱的阿塞拜疆大奖赛中登上领奖台。
而在另一个极端，斯特罗尔在职业生涯中的2020年土耳其大奖赛拿下过杆位，赛点车队强劲的RP20底盘以及他自己在半湿赛道上的优势让他大放异彩。那一年他没有在任何一站的Q1中被淘汰。
然而，他最近的多个赛季大多都在排位赛第一阶段为摆脱淘汰区而挣扎，因为阿斯顿·马丁的竞争力每况愈下，而他的纪录还因威廉姆斯艰难的2018赛季而进一步恶化，那一年他在Q1被淘汰了15次。本赛季他甚至没有一次逃出过Q1。
detailEn: Lance Stroll becomes first F1 driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations
The Aston Martin driver qualified last at Monza to become the first driver to hit the century since F1 introduced its three-part qualifying format in 2006
Lance Stroll managed an unwanted Formula 1 record as he became the first driver to register 100 Q1 eliminations since the three-part qualifying system was introduced in 2006.

The Canadian qualified last for Sunday's Italian Grand Prix, ending the session just under a tenth down on team-mate Fernando Alonso - although Alonso was unable to produce a final run at the close of the session.

This continues a weekend where Aston Martin, despite having been boosted in Zandvoort by the arrival of an updated Honda powertrain and additional upgrades to augment its Hungary overhaul, was exposed by its overall lack of power.
The AMR26 was consistently 20km/h down on the Mercedes cars, contributing to much of the 2.6s deficit to Pierre Gasly's Alpine around the lap during Q1.

Stroll, however, was as curt as ever in his responses as he was wholly unsurprised by Aston Martin's lack of pace. His enthusiasm, or lack thereof, did not perk up at the prospect of Sunday's race either - suggesting that the two green cars would be miles off throughout.
"It was what we expected [with the] engine," he said. "We're three seconds off, so we're not going to stay with the pack tomorrow."

Stroll secured his first Q1 elimination in his first F1 race, driving for Williams at the 2017 Australian Grand Prix, and was nine-tenths shy of Marcus Ericsson - who was the final driver to secure progression to Q2 on that weekend.

He rebounded with a Q3 appearance in the following weekend at Shanghai, although contact with Sergio Perez put an end to his race on the opening lap. However, Stroll claimed his maiden F1 points at his home race in Montreal, following that up with a podium finish at a wild Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

At the other end of the spectrum, Stroll has secured a pole position during his career at 2020 Turkish Grand Prix, coming alive with Racing Point's potent RP20 chassis and his own strengths on damp circuits. He did not record a single drop in Q1 during that year.

However, most of his recent seasons have been spent fighting against the drop zone in the first part of qualifying as Aston Martin's fortunes have dwindled, and his record augmented by Williams' difficult 2018 in which he dropped out in Q1 on 15 occasions. He has not escaped Q1 at all this season.

考虑到法拉利的两位车手在第二节排位赛中仅名列第九和第十快，这个最终成绩可以说是相当幸运，其中汉密尔顿仅以0.001秒之差险些爆冷早早出局，淘汰他的是奥迪车队的 博托莱托。
回顾自己在排位赛中的表现——这场排位赛被车手们主导，大家都在努力确保在赛道上获得能带来尾流加速的“拖拽”效果——以第五快成绩完赛的汉密尔顿对天空体育F1表示：“确实非常、非常艰难，是的。
“赛车在练习赛中感觉非常好，排位赛里我什么都没改，所以进入Q1时我感觉不错，Q1跑得很扎实。
“然后我们坐下来等待，在Q2的第一轮出场前我们在维修通道里等了很久，但不知为什么我们就是没有速度。我不太确定原因，可能是胎压、胎温还是别的什么，所以我们需要研究一下。

“然后Q3的执行相当糟糕。最后我一个人在空无一人的地方跑，而当你跟在另一辆赛车后面时，你会以快好几千米的速度进入弯角，所以刹车距离就得调整。这全在于进入节奏，而我在Q3的第一节跑中节奏完全乱了。”
“Q3第二节跑，那一圈不算太糟，但所有参照点都变了，最终我们没能做到最好。”
名列第三的Leclerc形容这次排位赛是“一场艰难的挣扎”，并指出“背后有许多我们不得不处理的问题”。
勒克莱尔补充道：“我很确定，如果我们在围场里聊一聊，每个人都会遇到一些问题，因为这是对动力单元进行优化最困难的赛道之一。但这不是借口。”
“皮埃尔和阿尔派做得非常完美，我认为他们通过完成一份完美的工作让围场里的所有人都感到惊讶。顺便说一句，我为皮埃尔感到非常高兴。”
“现在我们的任务就是努力挽回今天某种程度上由我们自己造成的损失。我认为杆位是不可能的，但再前进一个位置或许是可以做到的，我们需要以最大化一切为目标，而今天我们没有做到。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）和马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛三练中展开了贴身轮对轮的较量。
法拉利能否在正赛中克服梅赛德斯在直道上的优势？
尽管周六遇到了困难，法拉利仍然位于周日发车格的前列，因此不能将他们排除在争冠行列之外，不过从第二位发车的梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）很可能仍是夺冠热门。
法拉利在蒙扎引入了升级版引擎，这原本被期望能提升他们的夺冠机会，但汉密尔顿表示梅赛德斯在直道速度上仍然占据优势。
"我认为我们有一辆非常棒的车，"他说。
"我们前面都是梅赛德斯的引擎，我认为我们已经做得很好，能够与他们如此接近，但他们最终仍在直道上快出几个十分之一秒。事实就是这样，所以我们只能尽力做到最好。"
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）开着一辆罕见的法拉利F40抵达意大利大奖赛，并透露这辆车的引擎编号与他的赛车号码相同。
“我们希望未来能有一些不那么依赖功率的赛道，但我非常感谢工厂里的伙计们，因为他们确实为这里带来了升级，他们一直在努力。这就是我们所处的现状。”
鉴于预期比赛将重回赛季早些时候的“拉锯式”节奏，勒克莱尔希望在正赛高速圈中，能量释放方式上可能存在的差异，仍能为车队带来机会。
“在直道上，梅赛德斯非常强。在弯道中，我们非常强，但我们在直道上会非常暴露，想要进攻会很困难，”他说。
“但能量释放方式无论如何都可能产生巨大差异，并给我们超车的机会。我们必须打得聪明一些，看看最终结果如何。”

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team's execution of Italian GP qualifying could have been better after 'very tough' session

Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc reflect on Ferrari's frustrating lack of pace during qualifying at the Italian Grand Prix in Monza.

Lewis Hamilton felt Ferrari’s execution of the final stage of Italian Grand Prix qualifying had been "pretty bad" after the home team’s hopes of being able to challenge for pole position on Saturday fell flat.

Ferrari had been tipped to contend for pole at their home Monza race but never truly appeared in the hunt at any stage of the knockout sessions with the Scuderia eventually outpaced in Q3 by three Mercedes-powered cars - including Alpine surprise polesitter Pierre Gasly.
Oscar Piastri's later three-place grid penalty means Charles Leclerc and Hamilton will still both start on the second row in third and fourth places respectively.

That final result could be viewed as fortunate given Ferrari's drivers had finished only ninth and 10th quickest in Q2, with Hamilton just avoiding a shock early exit at the hands of Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto by 0.001s.

Reflecting on how his session had gone in a qualifying dominated by drivers trying to ensure they had a slipstream-boosting 'tow' on track, fifth-fastest Hamilton told Sky Sports F1: "It was definitely very, very tough, yes.
"The car felt really good in practice and in qualifying I didn't change anything, so I felt good going into Q1, and Q1 was solid.

"Then we sat and waited, and we waited very long in the pit lane for the first run of Q2, and for some reason we just didn't have the pace. I'm not really sure why, whether it was tyre pressures, tyre temperatures or whatever, so we need to look into that.

"Then execution in Q3 was pretty bad. I ended up out in the middle of nowhere with nobody, and then when you're following another car, you arrive several kilometres faster into a corner, so the braking distances adjust. It's all about getting into rhythm, and I got really out of rhythm for Q3, run one.
"Q3, run two, it wasn't a terrible lap but the references were all different, and we ultimately didn't maximise."
Third-placed Leclerc described qualifying as "a big struggle", pointing to "many issues in the background that we had to deal with".
Leclerc added: "I'm pretty sure if we speak in the paddock, everyone had some issues, because it's one of the most difficult tracks to optimise the power unit on. But that's not an excuse.
"Pierre and Alpine did everything perfect and I think they surprised everyone in the paddock by doing a perfect job. I'm very happy for Pierre by the way.

"Now it's our job to try and recover what we kind of lost on our own today. I don't think pole was possible but one place better was probably doable and we need to target on maximising everything and today we didn't."

Can Ferrari overcome Mercedes' straight strengths in race?

Despite their Saturday difficulties, Ferrari remain at the sharp end of Sunday's grid and therefore cannot be counted out of victory contention, although Mercedes' George Russell will likely remain favourite to win the race from second on the grid.
Ferrari have introduced an upgraded engine at Monza, which was expected to boost their victory chances, but Hamilton says Mercedes continue to hold an edge on straight-speed.
"I think we have a really great car," he said.

"It's all Mercedes engines up ahead of us and I think we've done a good job to be as close as we are to them, but they're ultimately gaining several tenths still on the straight. That is what it is, and so we have to just do the best we can.
Lewis Hamilton arrived at the Italian GP in a rare Ferrari F40 and revealed that the car's engine bore the same number as his racing number.

"We're hoping for some tracks that don't maybe rely too much on power in the future, but I'm really grateful to the guys back at the factory because they did bring a upgrade here, they are really pushing. This is just the situation that we're in."

Leclerc hopes that potential differences in approach to energy deployment around the high-speed lap in the race could still offer up opportunities for the Scuderia amid expectations of a return to the 'yo-yo' racing of earlier in the season.
"On the straights, Mercedes are very strong. In the corners, we are very strong but we are going to be very exposed on the straights and to attack will be difficult," he said.
"But the deployment could make a huge difference one way or another and give us the opportunity to overtake. We will have to play it smart and see where we end up."

items.originalTitle: 皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎夺得F1生涯首个杆位，激动不已
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed the first pole position of his Formula 1 career in qualifying at Monza, driving for Alpine and calling the track "something special". Six years ago he took his only grand prix win so far at the same circuit.
detailZh: “这里有些特别的东西”——皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎获得个人首个一级方程式杆位后欣喜若狂
这位阿尔卑斯车队的车手表示，为了庆祝自己的第一个一级方程式杆位，他已经“等了九年”，而且能在他第一次赢得大奖赛的同一地点蒙扎拿下杆位，这让这一刻更加特别
“我喜欢这条赛道，”皮埃尔·加斯利一边把他的阿尔卑斯赛车开进赛后检录区一边打趣道。不是开进其他车手通常使用的围栏区，而是朝着一级方程式发车区上标着1号位的立柱开去
六年前，在新冠疫情最严重的时候，加斯利在蒙扎取得了他职业生涯迄今唯一的分站冠军，在俯瞰空荡荡看台的荒凉领奖台上庆祝。而周六则截然不同，加斯利得以向观众、他的车队以及他欣喜若狂的父母致意
"出发，出发！我一直在等这一天！"当比赛工程师告知他这个结果时，他通过无线电大喊道，与此同时他的阿尔卑斯车库团队瞬间化作一片欢呼挥舞的海洋。
如果说他2020年驾驶阿尔法·托利（AlphaTauri）夺冠纯属意外——尽管也有形势的助推——那么这一次在速度圣殿直面正面对决，击败梅赛德斯、法拉利和迈凯伦的强大阵容，就更加出乎意料了。
皮埃尔·加斯利坐在领奖台上，回味他在2020年意大利大奖赛的胜利。
加斯利在第一轮练习后已经以令人惊艳的第三名完赛，但他没有止步于此。在最后一轮中，他借助法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿的尾流实现拖曳（tow）加速，超越乔治·拉塞尔和迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，仅以0.060秒的微弱优势夺得杆位，充分发挥了阿尔卑斯强劲的梅赛德斯动力单元在蒙扎高速赛道布局中的优势。
"从第一节排位赛的第一圈开始，我在车里感觉就非常好，每一节都在努力一点点提升。那一圈感觉非常棒，"这位法国车手解释道。
"我太开心了，我追逐杆位、争取拿到杆位的机会已经整整九年了。在蒙扎赢得我的第一场分站冠军，又在这条赛道拿到我的第一个杆位，我觉得在这里有些东西很特别。
夏尔·勒克莱尔祝贺皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎拿下杆位。
赛前夺冠热门拉塞尔起初听到自己被加斯利以微弱优势击败时十分震惊，但随后很快对这位30岁车手表示了赞赏。"向皮埃尔表示热烈祝贺，因为这是一次不可思议的表现，"拉塞尔说道。
“其实在大奖赛排位赛开始前15分钟，我们刚下完一盘国际象棋，他赢了我，我当时想：‘我觉得我会在排位赛里赢你’。结果现在，他又跑到我前面去了。
“没拿到杆位我挺失望的，维斯塔潘在前面开圈稍微有点乱，我的飞驰圈跑得非常接近（完美）。但加斯利和阿尔派一直非常快，从第一节排位赛（Q1）开始就是这样。”
在加斯利和拉塞尔之后，皮亚斯特里和夏尔·勒克莱尔原本将占据第二排发车位，不过这位迈凯伦车手因阻挡他人已被国际汽联比赛干事传唤，很可能面临发车位罚退。
detailEn: "Something special here" - Pierre Gasly ecstatic to take maiden F1 pole in Monza
The Alpine driver says he was "waiting for nine years" to celebrate his first Formula 1 pole, and felt taking it at the same venue as his first grand prix win in Monza made it even more special

"I like this track," Pierre Gasly quipped as he steered his Alpine into parc ferme. Not into the usual enclosure for the rest of the pack, but towards the bollard indicating the number 1 on the Formula 1 grid.

Six years ago, Gasly took his hitherto only career win in Monza at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, celebrating on a desolate podium overseeing empty grandstands. Not so on Saturday, where Gasly was able salute the crowd, his crew and his ecstatic parents.
"Let's go, let's go! I've been waiting for that one!" he yelled into his radio as he was informed by his race engineer of his fate, while his Alpine garage crew morphed into a sea of limbs.

If his AlphaTauri win in 2020 came as a total surprise, though aided by the circumstances, then defeating the might of Mercedes, Ferrari and McLaren at the Temple of Speed in a straight shootout was even more unexpected.
Pierre Gasly sits down on the podium to contemplate his 2020 Italian GP victory.

Gasly had already been an impressive third after the first set of runs, but didn't stop there. On the final run, he leapfrogged both George Russell and McLaren's Oscar Piastri by finding a tow from Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton to claim pole by a mere 0.060s, making the most of Alpine's powerful Mercedes power unit around Monza's high-speed layout.
"From the first lap in Q1, I felt very good in the car, trying to chip away a little bit every single session. It felt like a very good lap," the Frenchman explained.

"I am so happy, it's been nine years trying to chase and get the opportunity to get a pole position. To win my first race in Monza, get my first pole on this track, I think it's something special around here.
Charles Leclerc congratulates Pierre Gasly on his Monza pole.

Pre-event favourite Russell was initially shocked to hear he had been pipped by Gasly but was quick to praise the 30-year-old afterwards. "Massive congratulations to Pierre, because that's an incredible performance," Russell said.
"We actually finished a game of chess 15 minutes before qualifying and he beat me there, and I thought: 'I think I'll beat you in qualifying'. And here we are, he's ahead of me again.
"I was disappointed not to get the pole position, it was a bit messy with [Max] Verstappen opening the lap, I did the lap super close. But Pierre and Alpine have been super fast, even from Q1."
Behind Gasly and Russell, Piastri and Charles Leclerc were set to occupy to second row, though the McLaren driver has been summoned by the FIA race stewards for impeding and faces a likely grid drop.

items.titleZh: 加斯利与阿尔派惊险夺意大利大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利为阿尔派车队出人意料地夺得杆位，击败了梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔。
items.originalTitle: 加斯利与阿尔派惊险夺意大利大奖赛杆位
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed a shock pole position for Alpine in Italian Grand Prix qualifying at Monza, beating George Russell's Mercedes to the top spot.
detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利为阿尔派F1车队在蒙扎的意大利大奖赛排位赛中惊人地夺得杆位，击败了拉塞尔的梅赛德斯登上榜首。
最近升级后的阿尔派在练习赛中看起来拥有进入前十的速度，但没有人想到它在排位赛中会成为杆位的争夺者。
然而加斯利从第一节排位赛最早的几个飞驰圈开始就非常快，他在该节排名第一，队友弗朗哥·科拉平托位列第四。
第二节排位赛稍微艰难一些，加斯利最终位列第四，排在安东内利的梅赛德斯以及皮亚斯特里和诺里斯的两辆迈凯伦之后，而科拉平托则下滑到第八。
但在排位赛前十名对决（shootout）中，加斯利重新回到了竞争行列，在第三节（Q3）首轮计时圈中仅比拉塞尔的梅赛德斯慢了0.071秒，并排在皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦之后位列第三。
而在最后一轮计时圈中，尽管拉塞尔借助维斯塔潘的拖拽（tow）提高了0.083秒，但加斯利跟在一辆法拉利后面找到了更多速度，以0.06秒的优势夺得他在F1的首个杆位。
皮亚斯特里在第三节最后一圈时在第一个减速弯锁死了轮胎，但他的首个计时圈成绩仍然足以让他排名第三——不过他是否会在第二节（Q2）中因阻挡劳森的红牛而受到处罚仍是疑问。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿的法拉利分别排在第四和第五位，他们险些在第二节被淘汰，那一次博托莱托的奥迪差点将汉密尔顿淘汰出局，而且只比勒克莱尔慢了0.008秒。
维斯塔潘的红牛排在第六位，落后于积分榜领先者安东内利，后者为了帮助拉塞尔争夺杆位而放弃了自己的第三节排位赛。
由于本周末更换了新引擎，安东内利将从发车区末位起步。
科拉平托驾驶第二辆阿尔派获得第八名，排在诺里斯之前，后者在第三节排位赛的最后一圈受到皮亚斯特里在一号弯锁死车轮的影响——失去了整整一圈的尾流牵引。
阿维德·林德布拉德驾驶小红牛（小红牛）完成前十名，仅落后2025年世界冠军0.03秒。
博托莱托错过了第三节排位赛，仅比汉密尔顿的法拉利慢0.001秒，他懊悔在阿斯卡里（Ascari）减速弯中间发生打滑，但由于安东内利受到发车位置处罚，他无论如何将从第10位发车。
奥利·比尔曼的哈斯、尼科·霍肯伯格的奥迪、表现受损的劳森的红牛、卡洛斯·塞恩斯的威廉姆斯以及埃斯特班·奥康的哈斯是第二节排位赛中被淘汰的其他赛车。
在第一节排位赛中，被淘汰的是角田裕毅的小红牛和亚历山大·阿尔本的威廉姆斯，它们与预料之中的凯迪拉克以及阿斯顿·马丁-本田一起止步于此。
角田裕毅在本节结束后通过车队无线电被要求冷静下来，而威廉姆斯则感谢阿尔本帮助塞恩斯获得牵引（tow）进入第二节排位赛。
瓦尔特里·博塔斯仅比阿尔本的威廉姆斯慢0.008秒，在这场垫底较量中，费尔南多·阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁在第一节排位赛没有做出第二跑，比塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的凯迪拉克慢了超过半秒——能量匮乏的蒙扎赛道残酷地暴露了升级版本田引擎仍存在的动力差距。

detailEn: Pierre Gasly claimed a shock pole position for the Alpine Formula 1 team in Italian Grand Prix qualifying at Monza, beating George Russell's Mercedes to the top spot.
The recently upgraded Alpine looked top-10 fast through practice but no one was expecting it to be a pole threat come qualifying.
Yet Gasly was super quick from the earliest runs in Q1, where he was fastest of all and team-mate Franco Colapinto was fourth.
Q2 was slightly tougher, where Gasly ended up fourth behind Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes and the two McLarens of Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris, while Colapinto slipped to eighth.
But in the top-10 shootout Gasly came back into the picture, lapping just 0.071s behind Russell's Mercedes on the first Q3 runs, and placing third behind Piastri's McLaren.
And on the final runs, even though Russell found 0.083s thanks to a tow from Max Verstappen, Gasly found more by following a Ferrari to claim his first pole position in F1 by 0.06s.

Piastri locked up at the first chicane on his final Q3 run, but his first lap was still good enough for third - though questions remain as to whether he may be penalised for impeding Liam Lawson's Red Bull in Q2.

The Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were fourth and fifth, after narrowly avoiding Q2 elimination, where Gabriel Bortoleto's Audi almost eliminated Hamilton and was only 0.008s slower than Leclerc.
Verstappen's Red Bull rounded out the top six, ahead of championship leader Antonelli, who sacrificed his Q3 to aid Russell's pole bid.
Antonelli will drop to the back of the grid thanks to taking a new engine for this weekend.
Colapinto was eighth in the second Alpine, ahead of Norris, whose final Q3 lap was compromised by Piastri's Turn 1 lock-up - robbing Norris of a lap-long tow.
Arvid Lindblad completed the top 10 for Racing Bulls, just 0.03s down on the 2025 world champion.
Bortoleto missed out on Q3, just 0.001s down on Hamilton's Ferrari, ruing a slide in the middle of the Ascari chicane, but he will anyway start 10th thanks to Antonelli's grid penalty.
Ollie Bearman's Haas, Nico Hulkenberg's Audi, the compromised Red Bull of Lawson, the Williams of Carlos Sainz and Esteban Ocon's Haas were the other cars eliminated in Q2.
In Q1 it was Yuki Tsunoda's Racing Bulls and Alex Albon's Williams that joined the expected Cadillacs and Aston Martin-Hondas in being eliminated.
Tsunoda was told to calm down on team radio after the session, while Albon was thanked by Williams for helping tow Sainz into Q2.

Valtteri Bottas was only 0.008s slower than Albon's Williams in the battle at the back, where Fernando Alonso's Aston Martin, which didn't make a second run in Q1, was more than half a second slower than Sergio Perez's Cadillac as energy-starved Monza brutally exposed the upgraded Honda engine's remaining power shortfall.

items.summaryEn: McLaren driver Oscar Piastri has been given a three-place grid penalty for the Italian Grand Prix after impeding Liam Lawson during qualifying at Monza.
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在意大利大奖赛被处以发车顺位后退三位的处罚
迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因在排位赛中阻挡利亚姆·劳森而被处罚，失去了意大利大奖赛发车顺位中的第三位
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因在蒙扎排位赛中阻挡利亚姆·劳森，被处以意大利大奖赛发车顺位后退三位的处罚。这一处罚使这位迈凯伦车手从周日正赛的发车第三位降至第六位，夏尔·勒克莱尔、刘易斯·汉密尔顿和马克斯·维斯塔潘各前进一位。
该事件发生在排位赛第二节的最后时刻，当时劳森——作为受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔的替补，参加他今年代表红牛的第二场比赛——正在进行最后一个飞驰圈。
皮亚斯特里当时正在出站圈接近第一个减速弯，他减速让劳森的红牛队友维斯塔潘通过，因为红牛让它的车手们更早出站。
但这位迈凯伦车手随后在通过减速弯时插到了劳森前面，在大弯（Curva Grande）入口前的弯道出弯处阻挡了这位新西兰车手。

"干事们听取了81号车（奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里）车手、30号车（利亚姆·劳森）车手以及车队代表的陈述，并审查了定位/裁判系统数据、视频、计时、遥测数据、车队无线电以及车载视频证据，"国际汽联的决定写道。"驶出维修区时，81号车的车手被告知'维斯塔潘、劳森和赛恩斯正在通过，赛恩斯已进站。只剩维斯塔潘和劳森，你汇入时注意他们'。81号车的车手表示，他并未被提醒维斯塔潘和劳森正在进行飞驰圈（push lap），直到接近1号弯时才意识到维斯塔潘正在飞驰圈上。他大幅减速并靠右让维斯塔潘通过，但对于紧随其后的劳森，他无能为力，无法避免对其造成阻挡。"
"干事们接受，鉴于他所掌握的信息以及他所处的局面，81号车的车手在这一阶段没有其他选择，因此他无意中、同时也是不必要地阻挡了30号车。
"因此，处以标准的处罚：发车位置后退3位。"
在与干事会面之前，皮亚斯特里表示，他当时没有意识到劳森正在接近他。
"是的，我当时正驶出维修区，我是说，在这里驶出维修区时的速度差实在太大了，"皮亚斯特里在国际汽联（FIA）的新闻发布会上说。"所以，是的，我真的不知道他是从哪里冒出来的。我需要和车队一起复盘。"
劳森随后未能从第二节排位赛（Q2）中晋级，最终以第14名结束了该节排位赛。
“是的，我是说，这确实不太理想，”劳森说。“我们显然把事情留到了最后才试图做出一个计时圈。所以我只跑了一次就相当热了。然后，是的，显然在一号弯被阻挡也不理想。
“不过我是说，我们的目标本来就是这个周末专注于正赛。显然，我们明天有处罚。所以昨天我们本来就是在重点做长距离测试。
由于劳森这个周末驾驶的红牛赛车换装了新的动力单元部件，他已经注定要从发车区最后一位起步。
但尽管有发车区处罚，红牛仍然有理由争取让劳森进入第三节排位赛。计划是让他为维斯塔潘提供拖曳效应，这本来可以给他的队友在蒙扎的长直道上带来优势。
由于劳森在第二节排位赛中被淘汰，维斯塔潘成为红牛车队唯一进入排位赛最后一节的车手。他排位第六，随后因皮亚斯特里被罚退三位，他升至发车第五位。
当阻挡行为发生在排位赛期间时，罚退三个发车位是此类情况下的标准处罚。
detailEn: Oscar Piastri hit with three-place Italian GP grid penalty
McLaren driver Oscar Piastri has lost his third place on the Italian Grand Prix grid after being penalised for impeding Liam Lawson in qualifying

Oscar Piastri has been handed a three-place grid penalty for the Italian Grand Prix after impeding Liam Lawson during qualifying at Monza. The penalty drops the McLaren driver from third to sixth on the grid for Sunday's race, promoting Charles Leclerc, Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen by one position each.
The incident occurred in the dying moments of Q2, as Lawson - competing in his second Red Bull race of the year as a replacement for the injured Isack Hadjar - was on his final flying lap.
Piastri was on an out-lap approaching the first chicane and slowed to allow Lawson's Red Bull team-mate Verstappen through, with Red Bull having sent its drivers out earlier.
But the McLaren driver then slotted in ahead of Lawson through the chicane, delaying the New Zealander on the exit of the corner leading onto Curva Grande.

"The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 81 (Oscar Piastri), the driver of Car 30 (Liam Lawson), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence," the FIA decision reads. "On leaving the pits, the driver of Car 81 was advised that “Verstappen, Lawson and Sainz just crossing, Sainz has pitted. Just Verstappen and Lawson, watch out for them as you join”. The driver of Car 81 stated that he was not alerted to the fact that VER and LAW were on push laps but realised as he was almost at turn 1 that VER was on a push lap. He slowed significantly and kept to the right to allow VER to pass but was unable to do anything to avoid impeding LAW who was close behind.

"The Stewards accept that with the information he had, and the situation he was placed in, the driver of Car 81 had, at this stage, no other options available and hence, inadvertently, and also unnecessarily, impeded Car 30.
"Therefore the standard penalty of a drop of 3 grid positions is imposed."
Speaking before his meeting with the stewards, Piastri said he had not realised Lawson was approaching him.

“Yeah, I was coming out of the pits and, I mean, the speed difference out of the pits is so, so big here,” Piastri said at the FIA press conference. “So, yeah, I don't really know where he came from. I need to review with the team.”
Lawson subsequently failed to progress from Q2, ending the session in 14th place.

“Yeah, I mean, it just wasn't ideal,” Lawson said. “We obviously left it to the end there to try and put a lap together. So I was pretty hot after just one call. And then, yeah, obviously not ideal getting blocked at turn one.
“But I mean, the goal was to try and focus this weekend on the race anyway. Obviously, we've got the penalty for tomorrow. So yesterday we were very long runs focus anyway.”
Lawson is already set to start from the back of the grid due to new power unit components being fitted to the Red Bull he is driving this weekend.

But despite his grid penalty, Red Bull still had a reason to try to get Lawson into Q3. The plan was for him to provide Verstappen with a tow, which could have given his team-mate an advantage on Monza's long straights.

With Lawson knocked out in Q2, Verstappen was Red Bull's sole representative in the final part of qualifying. He qualified sixth, before Piastri's three-place penalty promoted him to fifth on the grid.
A three-place grid penalty is the standard sanction in such cases when the impeding occurs during qualifying.

items.summaryEn: On the track where he claimed his maiden grand prix win, Alpine driver Pierre Gasly took his first-ever Formula 1 pole position at Monza. In a thrilling Q3 shootout, he beat pre-session favourite George Russell by just 0.060s to deny the Mercedes driver a fifth pole of the year.
detailZh: F1 意大利大奖赛：皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎爆冷夺得生涯首个杆位
这位阿尔卑斯车手震惊了前排争夺者们，在意大利大奖赛上夺得了他有史以来第一个一级方程式杆位
在他首次赢得分站冠军的地方，阿尔卑斯车手皮埃尔·加斯利又在自己的职业生涯中写下了光辉的一页，在蒙扎夺得了他有史以来的第一个杆位。
在扣人心弦的第三节排位赛（排位赛决胜轮）中，加斯利仅以0.060秒的优势击败了赛前被看好的拉塞尔，使这位梅赛德斯车手错失了今年的第五个杆位，并让阿尔卑斯登上了成绩榜首位。
拉塞尔在最后的排位赛对决中先声夺人，做出1分21.929秒的单圈，排在皮亚斯特里、加斯利和勒克莱尔之前。
由于前十名车手的差距不到0.2秒，占据理想的赛道位置以利用尾流就显得至关重要，而拉塞尔手中还有一张王牌，那就是队友安东内利。
安东内利因引擎处罚将从最后一排发车，因此这位意大利车手被要求在5.8公里的赛道上为拉塞尔提供尾流牵引。
但加斯利也把策略打到了极致，他借用了法拉利车手汉密尔顿的尾流，做出了一个出色的单圈，超越了拉塞尔。
皮亚斯特里和勒克莱尔分列第三和第四，之后是汉密尔顿和马克斯·维斯塔潘。安东内利排名第七，但将在发车区失去这个位置，弗朗哥·科拉平托因此升至第七。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在排位赛中获得第三后被传唤至赛事干事处。
诺里斯最终只获得令人失望的第九名，因为他无法从队友皮亚斯特里身上获得尾流，而皮亚斯特里在一号弯冲出了赛道。这样一来，这位澳大利亚车手毁掉了自己的计时圈，也让诺里斯只能独自在空气中‘打洞’（没有尾流可跟）。皮亚斯特里和诺里斯都在一号弯的刹车环节遇到困难，此外皮亚斯特里预计还将因阻挡利亚姆·劳森而接受调查。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德排位赛获得第十名，由于安东内利受到处罚，他将上升到第九位。
第二节排位赛的第一轮飞驰圈结束后，法拉利的汉密尔顿处于淘汰区，他的飞驰圈似乎在不合适的时间遇到了慢车，这让这位七届世界冠军不得不在最后一圈里完成大量工作。
由于勒克莱尔同样面临压力排在第九，两位队友都无法帮助另一辆红车。勒克莱尔未能提升自己的单圈成绩，但汉密尔顿确实设法从SF-26中榨出了半个十分之一秒，以微小的0.001秒优势将奥迪的博尔托莱托挤了下去，让车队避免了尴尬。
排在博尔托莱托之后被淘汰的是哈斯的贝尔曼，他使用升级过的赛车和动力单元取得第12名。心情不佳的劳森在第13名被淘汰，这让红牛失去了在第三节排位赛中为维斯塔潘提供拖拽的机会。
劳森连续第二个周末顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔出赛，他将因发动机处罚与安东内利一起排在发车榜的最后。
尼科·霍肯伯格、卡洛斯·塞恩斯和埃斯特班·奥孔也在第二节排位赛结束时止步。
第一节排位赛出人意料地由加斯利领跑，领先于维斯塔潘和诺里斯，而这成为了小红牛替补车手角田裕毅的终点站，他代替劳森参加了这位新西兰人的车队（的排位赛）。
角田裕毅未能做出干净的飞行圈，以第17名的成绩位于晋级线之外，让威廉姆斯车队的塞恩斯以0.139秒的优势逃入第二节排位赛。
塞恩斯的队友阿尔本也发挥了作用，在直道上为这位西班牙车手提供了关键的尾流牵引，而这位英泰混血车手当时仅排在第18位。
凯迪拉克击败了阿斯顿·马丁，位居队尾之争的上风，博塔斯和佩雷兹轻松领先于陷入困境的阿隆索和斯特罗尔。阿隆索因本田动力单元出现问题，未能完成最后一轮行驶。
不过，阿斯顿·马丁不会从发车区的最后一排发车，因为劳森和安东内利因更换引擎受罚而排在最后。

detailEn: F1 Italian GP: Pierre Gasly takes shock maiden pole at Monza
The Alpine driver shocks the frontrunners to take his first-ever Formula 1 pole position at the Italian Grand Prix
On the scene of his maiden grand prix win, Alpine driver Pierre Gasly has written another gilt-edged chapter in his Formula 1 career by claiming his first-ever pole in Monza.
In a thrilling Q3 shootout, Gasly trumped pre-session favourite George Russell by a mere 0.060s to deny the Mercedes driver a fifth pole of the year and take Alpine to the top of the timesheets.
Russell had drawn first blood in the final shootout with a 1m21.929s lap, ahead of Oscar Piastri, Gasly and Charles Leclerc.

With the entire top 10 covered by less than two tenths, getting optimal track position to benefit from a slipstream proved crucial, with Russell have an ace up his sleeve in the shape of team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
Antonelli is set to start on the last row due to an engine penalty, so the Italian was asked to tow Russell around the 5.8km track.
But Gasly also played his cards to perfection by grabbing a slipstream from Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, and delivered an outstanding lap to leapfrog Russell.
Piastri and Leclerc were third and fourth, followed by Hamilton and Max Verstappen. Antonelli was seventh but will lose that position on the grid, elevating Franco Colapinto to seventh.
Oscar Piastri has been summoned to the stewards after qualifying third

Norris was a disappointed ninth after not being able to grab a slipstream from team-mate Piastri, who went off in Turn 1. In doing so, the Australian ruined his own lap and left Norris punching a hole in the air by himself. Piastri and Norris had both struggled under brakes in Turn 1, and Piastri is also expected to be investigated for blocking Liam Lawson.
Arvid Lindblad qualified 10th and will move up to ninth as a result of Antonelli's penalty.

The first barrage of Q2 runs left Ferrari's Hamilton in the drop zone, appearing to catch traffic at the wrong time on his run, which left the seven-time world champion with a lot of work to do on his final run.

With Leclerc also under pressure in ninth, neither team-mate was in a position to help the other red car. Leclerc was unable to improve his lap., but Hamilton did manage to wrangle half a tenth out of the SF-26, demoting Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto by a minuscule 0.001s margin and sparing the Scuderia's blushes.

Bortoleto was followed out by Haas' Oliver Bearman, who used an upgraded car and power unit to take 12th. An unhappy Lawson was eliminated in 13th, denying Red Bull a chance to give Verstappen a tow in Q3.
Lawson, who replaces the injured Isack Hadjar for the second consecutive weekend, will join Antonelli at the back of the grid with an engine penalty.
Nico Hulkenberg, Carlos Sainz and Esteban Ocon also exited the session at the end of Q2.

Q1, which was surprisingly headed by Gasly ahead of Verstappen and Norris, proved the final station for Racing Bull's replacement driver Yuki Tsunoda, who stood in for Lawson at the New Zealander's regular team.
Tsunoda was on the wrong end of the cut-off in 17th after failing to deliver a clean lap, allowing Williams driver Sainz to escape to Q2 by 0.139s.
Sainz's team-mate Alex Albon also played a role by handing the Spaniard a crucial tow on the straight while the Anglo-Thai driver was down in 18th.

Cadillac defeated Aston Martin at the bottom of the order, with Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez comfortably ahead of a struggling Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll. Alonso didn't complete a final run due to a Honda power unit problem.
Aston Martin won't have to start on the last row of the grid, however, with Lawson and Antonelli stuck there after their engine change penalties.

Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Italian Grand Prix
Pierre Gasly produced a sensational performance to claim his first career pole position in F1 as the Alpine driver stunned the grid's usual frontrunners at the Italian Grand Prix.
A day after losing his podium finish from June's Monaco Grand Prix for a second time after a court ruling, Gasly was unexpectedly a threat at the front throughout qualifying at high-speed Monza.

The Frenchman was third on the timesheet heading into the final Q3 runs before saving his best until last to usurp provisional polesitter George Russell and take the coveted top spot with a surging final lap of 1:21.786.

Gasly's first pole in F1, for his 190th race, comes six years after he claimed what stands as his sole career win, also at Monza, which was achieved in similarly unlikely circumstances for AlphaTauri.
It is the first pole position in F1 for the Alpine name and a first for the Renault-owned Enstone team since 2009.
Pierre Gasly snatches pole position from George Russell!
Russell was left to rue a "messy" start to his final lap behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen and he missed out on pole by 0.060s.
But the Briton still starts on the front row in second for a race in which championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli will start among the grid's back rows due to engine-change penalties.
Antonelli, who helped Russell with a tow during qualifying, took seventh but always knew he would drop to the back wherever he qualified.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri qualified third but was handed a three-place grid penalty after the session for blocking Red Bull's Liam Lawson in Q2.
Oscar Piastri was given a three-place grid penalty for this block on Liam Lawson at the end of Q2
Piastri drops to sixth on Sunday's grid as a result with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton promoted to third and fourth respectively, with Verstappen into fifth.
Both Ferraris will now start on the second row despite a difficult qualifying session in which their expected pole-contending pace never materialised.

Indeed, the Scuderia had been fortunate to get both cars into the top 10 at all after Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto finished just 0.001s behind 10th-fastest Hamilton at the end of Q2. Leclerc had been ninth.
**will drop to back of grid for engine penalties
After consecutive poles and race wins either side of the summer break, reigning champion Lando Norris qualified only ninth.
The Briton was shorn of a tow on his final lap of Q3 after a Piastri error at the first chicane in front of him, although moves up to eighth on the grid owing to Antonelli's penalties.
With the championship leader dropping to the back, Gasly's Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto takes over seventh with Norris eighth and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad ninth. Bortoleto ends up 10th.
Gasly delivers qualifying shock for the ages at the Temple of Speed

After the frustration of Friday - when Gasly and Alpine learned from the FIA's International Court of Appeal that his pit-lane speeding penalties from June's Monaco race would be reapplied and so he would drop from third to seventh in a result revised for the second time - the prospect of them delivering such an eye-catching response on track would have appeared far-fetched.
Alpine are enjoying a much-improved season compared to 2025, when they finished last in the standings, but until Saturday had not started a race higher than seventh on the grid.

Gasly was ninth fastest in the day's earlier final practice session, six tenths of a second off Russell's benchmark pace, but their Mercedes-engined A526 car was suddenly a pole contender in the Frenchman's hands come qualifying.

With Alpine appearing to have trimmed out the car's rear-wing levels for F1's fastest track, Gasly led the way in Q1 before showing that was no fluke by finishing fourth-fourth in Q2 and still ahead of pole favourite Russell.
The first runs of Q3 then underlined that Gasly was a serious contender. Russell set the quickest time but Gasly remained right in the mix in third, just 0.072s behind.

The final run then played out absolutely perfectly for the Alpine driver. While Piastri blew his pole chance by locking up into the first chicane, and Russell's warm-up for his final attempt was compromised, Gasly seized his chance and jumped ahead of both.
Confirmation of pole triggered scenes of jubilation in the Alpine garage, with an emotional Gasly shouting on team radio: "Yessssss! Let's go. I've been waiting for that one!"

Reflecting on the achievement in his post-qualifying interview, the Frenchman said: "From the first lap in Q1, I felt very good in the car. I tried to chip away a little bit, every single session, and it felt like a very good lap.
"It's been nine years trying to chase the opportunity to get a pole.
"I won my first race in Monza and got my first pole at this track. It's something special around here."
